XDP and XDP socket require extra SQ/RQ/CQs. Most of these resources
are dynamically created: no XDP program loaded
created. One exception is the SQ/CQ created for XDP_REDRIECT
for other netdev to forward packet to mlx5 for transmit. The patch
disables creation of SQ and CQ used for egress XDP_REDIRECT
checking whether ndo_xdp_xmit is set or not.
For netdev without XDP support such as non-uplink representor
